work.helper.title: ask another agent
work.helper.says: Another agent reads this session’s work and answers your question; it changes nothing. Its answer comes back to this session as its next turn, marked as the helper’s.
work.helper.question: Your question
work.helper.asked: Asked another agent: its answer comes back to this session as its next turn, marked as the helper’s.
work.helper.heading: Helpers
work.helper.state.next: starts at the driver’s next look
work.helper.state.cap: waits for a running session to end
work.helper.state.agent: waits for an agent that can take it
work.helper.state.answered: {{agent}} answered: its answer is this session’s next turn
work.helper.approved: It has your yes: the driver starts a helper at its next look.
work.helper.declined: Not asked: no helper is started for it, and its session’s timeline says you said no.
work.helper.refused.blank: Write the question the helper is to answer.
work.helper.refused.too-long: A question is at most 4000 characters: shorten it.
work.helper.refused.agent: Name the agent as one word, as Settings lists it.
work.helper.refused.not-held: This session is not held on this machine, so no answer could come back to it.
work.helper.refused.helper: A helper cannot ask for a helper: ask from the session it helps.
work.helper.refused.reviewer: A second opinion’s reviewer cannot ask for a helper.
work.helper.refused.intake: An intake does no work in a repository, so it cannot ask for a helper.
work.helper.refused.gone: That ask is no longer this session’s.
work.helper.refused.person: It is your own ask, which needs no yes.
work.helper.refused.waits: It waits on a free slot or an agent, not on your yes.
work.helper.refused.past: It has started already, or ended: nothing waits on your yes.
work.helper.refused.approved: It has your yes already: the driver starts it at its next look.
work.helper.refused.unread: The driver has not read it yet: say no once it waits on your word.
